Description.SourceString:
How could I have known she was a witch?

I stole the seeds to feed myself, to make something from this scrap of land.

Now I am cursed. Cursed to become something that no-one will look twice at.

Even now, I can feel my mind failing me. the best I can do is find a fine spot. There, I suppose, I will live out the rest of my days.

Joe.
